description.value: Mac's is a University of Victoria Food Services cafe tucked into the A Wing of the MacLaurin Building on the UVic campus. It specializes in custom-made sandwiches and wraps alongside salads, daily soups, pastries, and a wide beverage selection. Cyclists visiting or passing through the UVic campus will find it a convenient spot for a fresh, made-to-order meal.
